【原视频简介】
Local Padako Masu Bhutuwa with Nepali Style || Rangako Masu Pakaune tarika || Kanchhikitchen
Namaste! 
Welcome to @KanchhiKitchen 
In today's video, we are sharing an authentic and traditional village-style recipe for Local Padako Masu Bhutuwa (राँगा/पाडाको मासु भुटुवा). Cooked with freshly ground traditional spices on a slow fire, this recipe gives you tender, juicy meat coated in rich, mouth-watering Nepali flavors.

Whether you enjoy it as a spicy side dish with beaten rice (baji/chiura) or as a main curry with steaming hot rice, this classic recipe will bring the true taste of Nepali village cooking right to your kitchen!

🕒 What’s in this Video:
Step-by-step slow-cooking process for deep flavor & perfect texture
Village-style serving ideas

🛒 Ingredients (सामग्रीहरू):
Local Pada/Ranga Meat (पाडा/राँगाको मासु): Cleaned & cut into bite-sized pieces

Mustard Oil (तोरीको तेल): For authentic rustic aroma

Whole Spices (खडा मसला): Bay leaves (तेजपात), Cinnamon (दालचिनी), Cardamom (सुकमेल/अलैंची), Cloves (ल्वाङ), Cumin seeds (जिरा)

Aromatics: Chopped Onions (प्याज), Fresh Ginger-Garlic paste (अदुवा-लसुनको पेस्ट), Green Chillies (हरियो खुर्सानी)
